prompt: Wide shot at golden hour: three cat astronauts, an orange tabby, a black-and-white tuxedo cat and a fluffy pale grey cat, each in a white cat-sized spacesuit with orange shoulder patches, each with its whole head and both ears sealed inside its own clear round glass bubble helmet joined to the suit by a silver neck ring, walk side by side across a concrete launch pad toward a tall white rocket on its tower, long shadows, warm sky.
